title: Gift Delivery Ecommerce System
summary: Multi-role e-commerce web platform isolating customer ordering, vendor fulfillment, and administrator operations through strict MVC architecture and SQLite relational integrity.
role_and_responsibilities: Full-Stack Engineer — Developed Django MVC backend, custom permission decorators for 3 user roles, transactional order processing, and responsive front-end views.
problem_statement: Coordinating product catalog updates, inventory reservations, and delivery routing across distinct customer and vendor actors without state drift or race conditions.
architecture_overview: Model-View-Controller architecture segregating presentation templates, view controllers, and ORM query logic. Custom permission decorators enforce role boundaries across admin, vendor, and customer dashboards.
problem_narrative: Multi-actor e-commerce storefronts split operational authority across customers placing orders, vendors updating catalog fulfillment, and administrators moderating platform activity. Without strict view-level isolation and transactional stock decrements, shared Django routes risk unauthorized privilege crossover and oversold inventory during checkout.
architecture_narrative: Server-rendered Django MVC template views enforce strict dashboard segregation via custom Python permission decorators rather than external REST endpoints. During checkout, the order service wraps cart line-item iteration inside transaction.atomic() with select_for_update row locking so order creation and cart clearance commit as one indivisible unit.
database_design: SQLite schema with relational foreign keys establishing strict integrity between Orders, LineItems, Products, and VendorProfiles with automatic cascade handling.

technical_specs.guarantee: Atomic stock updates & server-side form checks

architecture_standards: Built with modular Django applications isolating URL routing, server-side form validation, custom permission decorators, and HTML template rendering without exposing external API endpoints.
schema_guarantees: Uses SQLite with explicit foreign key constraints linking Orders, LineItems, Products, and VendorProfiles, protected by atomic checkout transactions and cascade handling.

verifiable_metrics.value: ACID compliance via Django ORM transactions
